gr_list.description: NLP Stages 4-7 C# port (intent classifier, FAQ extractor, sentiment analyzer, product analyzer) + query layer + Backend proxy

plan.summary: PKT-4: Full C# port of WA NLP stages 4-7 — IntentClassifierService (12 intent, keyword+Claude Haiku hybrid), FaqExtractorService (Q&A pair extraction + hash-bucket grouping), SentimentAnalyzerService (keyword+Claude hybrid scoring), ProductAnalyzerService (KMR codes + price heuristic). Pipeline auto-chains after stage 3. ClaudeClient for Haiku API batching. AnalyticsRepository batch inserts for 6 Phase B tables. 6 new query endpoints on WA service. Backend WhatsAppAnalyticsClient proxy (upload + CRUD + query).
plan.interview_notes: Q kararları: (1) Full C# port (Python subprocess yok), (2) Claude her zaman kullanılır (API key varsa), keyword-only fallback, (3) Otomatik pipeline devam (stage 3 → 4 → 5 → 6 → 7 → completed), (4) Backend proxy + query layer, (5) Hash-bucket FAQ grouping (O(N) bucket + O(bucket²) Levenshtein), (6) Config toggle yok — Claude API key yoksa otomatik keyword-only.

verification_questions.question: Do all new query endpoints validate JWT tenant_id against route tenantId, following the GetValidatedTenant pattern?
Do all AnalyticsRepository query methods include tenant_id WHERE clause, preventing cross-tenant data access?
Does ClaudeClient handle API failures (timeout, rate limit, parse error) gracefully with keyword-only fallback instead of failing the entire pipeline?

Are all batch INSERT operations for Phase B tables (wa_intents, wa_sentiments, wa_products, wa_prices, wa_faq_pairs, wa_faq_clusters) using parameterized queries with 50-row batching consistent with existing pattern?
Does the PipelineOrchestrator correctly chain stages 4-7 after stage 3, update wa_analyses status for each stage, and handle stage-level errors without losing prior stage data?

non_goals: Dashboard UI (PKT-3'te zaten var, query'ler burada eklenir)
pgvector embedding (FAQ clusters'a embedding eklenmeyecek bu fazda)
intentional_exclusions: Config toggle for Claude (Q: her zaman Claude kullan)
Stage 5 TF-IDF vectorizer (hash-bucket grouping ile replace)
FAQ cluster embedding (pgvector hazır olunca eklenebilir)
WA Dashboard UI components (PKT-3'teki mevcut WA dashboard yeterli)

try_catch_locations: IntentClassifierService.cs: Per-conversation Claude batch catch + keyword fallback
FaqExtractorService.cs: Q&A extraction + clustering catch + partial results preserved
SentimentAnalyzerService.cs: Per-conversation Claude batch catch + keyword fallback
ProductAnalyzerService.cs: Per-conversation regex catch + skip malformed data
PipelineOrchestrator.cs: Per-stage catch + continue to next stage (partial results preserved)
Program.cs: Every query endpoint try-catch + error response
user_facing_errors: INV-WA-007: Claude API hatası (keyword-only fallback aktif)
INV-WA-008: Claude yanıtı parse edilemedi (keyword-only fallback aktif)
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Claude API hatalarında keyword-only fallback kullanılır ve SystemWarn ile loglanır. Stage hatalarında pipeline hata mesajıyla fail eder. Query hataları error code ile döner. Hiçbir hata sessizce yutulmaz.
